topography.project_purpose: DOR. Structurally: 117 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 9 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 47 common project-authored base contract(s) (iprotocolpoolcontroller, rescuable, actionbase). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
